issue.title: warm reboot finalizer service could wait for not enabled component for 5 minutes

failure.body:
**Description**
With latest master / 202012 branch image. The warm reboot finalizer could wait for not enabled component to reconcile for 5 minutes.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. warm reboot
2.
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
warm reboot finalizer wait for

Jan  7 <IPV6>.519985 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Tearing down control plane assistant ...
Jan  7 <IPV6>.712066 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Save in-memory database after warm reboot ...
Jan  7 <IPV6>.301030 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Some components didn't finish reconcile: natsyncd ...
Jan  7 <IPV6>.302572 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Finalizing warmboot...

**Describe the results you expected:**

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**

    **Output of `show version`:**

    ```
    latest master.
    ```

    **Attach debug file `sudo generate_dump`:**

    ```
Jan  7 <IPV6>.519985 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Tearing down control plane assistant ...
Jan  7 <IPV6>.712066 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Save in-memory database after warm reboot ...
Jan  7 <IPV6>.301030 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Some components didn't finish reconcile: natsyncd ...
Jan  7 <IPV6>.302572 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Finalizing warmboot...
    ```

resolution.title: [warm boot finalizer] only wait for enabled components to reconcile
resolution.description:
**- Why I did it**
Fix issue #6383

**- How I did it**

Define the component with its associated service. Only wait for components that have associated service enabled to reconcile during warm reboot.

Signed-off-by: Ying Xie <<EMAIL>>

**- How to verify it**
Run warm reboot with the change (note that 'natsyncd' is no longer in the wait list:
/var/log/syslog.1:Jan 14 <IPV6>.239710 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Wait for database to become ready...
/var/log/syslog.1:Jan 14 <IPV6>.730254 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Database is ready...
/var/log/syslog.1:Jan 14 <IPV6>.104362 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Restoring counters folder after warmboot...
/var/log/syslog.1:Jan 14 <IPV6>.043684 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Waiting for components: ' neighsyncd bgp orchagent' to reconcile ...
/var/log/syslog:Jan 14 <IPV6>.913965 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Tearing down control plane assistant ...
/var/log/syslog:Jan 14 <IPV6>.123504 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Save in-memory database after warm reboot ...
/var/log/syslog:Jan 14 <IPV6>.727347 str-7260cx3-acs-1 NOTICE root: WARMBOOT_FINALIZER : Finalizing warmboot...
